symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of points along one axis of the transform being computed; it need not be a power of two.
symbols.quote: Here $L$ is the number of points along one axis of the transform.

symbols.name: point index
symbols.meaning: An index of a point along an axis, running over 0 to L-1.
symbols.quote: Here $u$ and $v$ are indices of points along an axis, running over $0,\dots,L-1$.

symbols.name: second point index
symbols.meaning: A second index of a point along an axis, running over 0 to L-1, used with u in the Gaussian weights.
symbols.quote: Here $u$ and $v$ are indices of points along an axis, running over $0,\dots,L-1$.

symbols.name: imaginary unit
symbols.meaning: The imaginary unit, with i squared equal to -1.
symbols.quote: Here $i$ is the imaginary unit, with $i^2=-1$.

relations.quote: Gaussian resampling is applied to the [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) of two integers, which needs transforms of lengths that are not powers of two.
